scope: one authorized site, two public services, one controlled industry test
opening_conditions: site authorization and closing time recorded
accountable service owner and named on-site takeover staff present
continuous no-app route walked before opening
physical stop and offline contacts tested
public source dates and data deletion time checked
issue log opened with privacy notice

run_of_day.action: walk the public route and record any blocked segment
rehearse paper service, phone contact, and physical stop
read source date, expiry, minimum fields, and stop rule aloud with staff
open Ask First and display the human takeover point
run one announced fault card without involving an unsuspecting visitor
close service, reconcile logs, delete expired test data, and publish the day status

fault_cards.expected_human_action: switch to paper and staffed route
fault_cards.stop_if: staff cannot complete the same task

fault_cards.trigger: critical bilingual information is mistranslated or stale
fault_cards.expected_human_action: cover the item, correct it from dated public source, and log the change

fault_cards.trigger: accessible route or emergency path is blocked
fault_cards.expected_human_action: stop the affected service and provide a staffed alternative

fault_cards.trigger: named takeover staff is absent or leaves the service point
fault_cards.expected_human_action: keep the public task on the staffed or paper route only and record the uncovered shift
fault_cards.maximum_claim: manual route retained where a qualified substitute is present
fault_cards.stop_if: no qualified substitute accepts the takeover and stop authority

fault_cards.trigger: personal, identifiable, or out-of-purpose data appears in an output or log
fault_cards.expected_human_action: stop processing, isolate the affected record, preserve a minimal incident trace, and begin the approved deletion and review path
fault_cards.stop_if: scope, affected records, deletion, or accountable reviewer cannot be confirmed

fault_cards.trigger: supplier support, model access, or a required digital dependency is withdrawn
fault_cards.expected_human_action: disconnect the dependency, export only authorized public records, return to the paper and staffed service, and inspect the site for removal
fault_cards.maximum_claim: ordinary service continues without the supplier dependency
fault_cards.stop_if: public records cannot be exported, data cannot be deleted, or the site cannot be restored

five_stop_drills.reopen_evidence: complete accessible and emergency-route replay signed by safety and access reviewers
dated source check plus successful paper-service replay
named shift and substitute both demonstrate the complete manual task
incident scope, deletion result, corrective action, and independent data review
authorized record export, dependency removal, site restoration, and ordinary-service replay

claim_boundary: This is a participant-authored operating rehearsal. It records no completed drill, field result, approval, staffing commitment, or implementation promise.
